excerpt: metal : check all fused nodes for concurrency The concurrency check for a fused group only examined the last node, so intermediate outputs (e.g. the TOPK_MOE ids/weights) and the group's sources (e.g. the router logits) were ignored. This allowed the fused top-k kernel to run concurrently with the router matmul that writes its input, producing nondeterministic expert routing. Check every node of the fused group instead.
